newsitem.title: UK: Copper ends with pared gains on LME.
newsitem.headline: Copper ends with pared gains on LME.

text.p: COPPER - Ends below three week high of $1,990 as market stalls near $2,000 and falls below $1,970 chart point. Spread level. ALUMINIUM - Drops with copper, ends softer but above $1,400. NICKEL - Closes softer, tentative deal at Inco Manitoba. ZINC - Bucks general late trend and holds up to close steadier. LEAD - Ends softer. TIN - Closes below $6,100. ALLOY - Stable.
